Guidance for Claude Code. MAF learning repository with PM Copilot, docs/examples.

```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env  # then fill in OPENAI_API_KEY at minimum
python app.py --console      # Interactive terminal
python app.py --server       # FastAPI server (Teams + local web chat + AG-UI)
python app.py --devui        # MAF Developer UI (visual debugging)
python app.py --copilotkit   # Alias for --server
cd maf_copilotkit/agent
uv venv && source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e .
uvicorn server:app --reload --port 8000
cd maf_copilotkit/web
pnpm install && pnpm dev
cd tmp-ag-ui
pnpm install && pnpm build
pnpm test    # run tests
pnpm lint    # lint code
pnpm dev     # watch mode for SDKs
```

Server: `POST /api/local_chat`, `POST /api/messages`, `GET /chat`, `/copilotkit`. `GRAPH_MODE=mock` default; `live` requires Azure credentials.

Star-topology: Triage routes to 5 specialists; specialists hand back. Triage: `maf/agents/triage.py`; orchestration: `maf/orchestration/handoff_workflow.py` via `HandoffBuilder`. Tools: `maf/tools/`, `<REDACTED_USER>(approval_mode="never_require")` with `Annotated`; Graph client: `maf/tools/graph_client.py`; config: `maf/config.py`; AG-UI: `maf/agui_endpoint.py`. Evaluation examples: `maf/agents/01_handoff/`–`05_magentic/`.

New tools go in `maf/tools/`, new agents in `maf/agents/`. New agents in the PM Copilot flow must be wired in `maf/orchestration/handoff_workflow.py`
Never commit `.env` files or secrets
Python 3.10+, PEP 8, `agent-framework==1.0.0rc4`. Update `ANTIGRAVITY.md` if architectural changes are made. See `ANTIGRAVITY.md` for MAF upgrade procedures.
